author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
I dont understand why the original thread was locked (@myworld) since the thread wasn't created to attack shadowolf and he clearly identified it as his opinions. Sure, the cancer part could be considered and could be redacted but the thread's point was fine.

PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS REFERS TO SHADOW'S HOSTING NOT HIM AS A PERSON AND THEREFORE IS NOT A PERSONAL ATTACK.

Shadowolf's hosting is the problem on avicusalert. His videos have consisted of him wearing green while in front of a green screen, a 7 minute clip of a goodbye thread (goodbye for 2 months) being read outloud, him bringing up topics such as avicus PR and forgetting any research he might have done. The videos are a mess of non-content and bloopers as shadowolf stumbles through each episode and for some reason he refuses to edit the terrible mistakes out. Most of the views and likes he gets are sarcastic memes.

Tynvale quit so hes not in consideration. Porky would be solid as a replacement but he is pretty far removed from the community nowadays. I say scrap it.

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Alright, it seems that people want a reason for why I originally locked the thread. Here it is:
To begin with, The original poster provided no constructive criticism. Claiming that a youtuber's videos "give me cancer" and that he shouldn't be running it because he's a "bad YouTuber and content creator in general" are not valid reasons for revoking a player's permissions  and are not just offensive, but are also opinionated.
I admit that I was also frustrated by the flippant use of "cancer". I don't like seeing it being used as a general insult considering how terrible the reality of that condition is. I don't enjoy reading posts where people use such an abhorrent condition in such a disgustingly ignorant manner.
Finally, the thread was intended to belittle another player, which is unnecessary. As the rules clearly state, derogatory posts and comments aren't allowed. 

Thanks.
